services.name: Fever, Viral & Infection Management
services.shortDesc: Clinical diagnosis and evidence-guided management of seasonal fevers, viral infections, dengue, typhoid, urinary tract infections, and flu.
services.suitableFor: Patients with high temperature, chills, sore throat, or body aches.

services.name: Diabetes & Hypertension Care
services.shortDesc: Continuous monitoring, medication optimization, and lifestyle guidance for Type 2 Diabetes, High Blood Pressure, and Lipid Disorders.
services.suitableFor: Long-term metabolic monitoring and dosage titration.

services.name: Annual Health Check & Risk Screening
services.shortDesc: Systematic evaluation of cardiovascular health, metabolic markers, liver/kidney profiles, and age-appropriate screening recommendations.
services.suitableFor: Adults and seniors seeking preventive wellness.

services.name: Asthma, Cough & Allergy Care
services.shortDesc: Assessment of chronic cough, seasonal allergic rhinitis, bronchospasm, and inhaler technique instruction.
services.suitableFor: Wheezing, persistent nocturnal cough, and seasonal allergies.

services.name: Routine Family & Pediatric Care
services.shortDesc: Primary care consultations for children over 2 years and family members with common illnesses, digestive complaints, and nutritional advice.

services.name: Minor Procedures & Vitals Screening
services.shortDesc: In-clinic sterile wound dressing, suture removal, nebulization, blood glucose finger-prick testing, and rapid ECG coordination.

testimonials.comment: Dr. Arjun Mehta took 20 minutes to review my 3-year lab history and explained why I did not need two of the extra medicines I was previously given. My HbA1c is now stable at 6.8 with proper lifestyle changes.
Very polite and attentive doctor. Did not prescribe unnecessary IV drips or expensive brand-name medicines. Guided us on hydration and fever monitoring. Recovered completely within 4 days.
Finding a family doctor who genuinely listens without hurrying is rare nowadays. The clinic is clean, well-ventilated, and wheelchair accessible from the parking area.

faqs.question: What is the consultation fee and what payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: The outpatient consultation fee is ₹400. This includes a comprehensive 15-minute examination, vitals screening, and a digitally printed prescription. We accept Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), and major Debit/Credit cards.

faqs.question: How does the 7-day follow-up consultation work?
faqs.answer: If you need a follow-up review for the same illness within 7 days of your initial visit (e.g. to review new blood test reports or monitor fever progression), the follow-up consultation is completely complimentary (₹0).

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment or can I walk in directly?
faqs.answer: Walk-in patients are always welcome during morning (10:00 AM – 1:30 PM) and evening (5:30 PM – 9:00 PM) OPD hours. However, priority tokens are allocated to patients who request an appointment slot online or via WhatsApp, which reduces your waiting room time.

faqs.question: Does submitting a website enquiry guarantee my appointment time?
faqs.answer: No. Submitting the web enquiry notifies our clinic reception. Our team verifies the doctor's real-time schedule and confirms your slot with a consultation token via WhatsApp message or telephone call.

faqs.question: Where is Aarogya Family Clinic located and is parking available?
faqs.answer: We are located at Shop No. 12, Ground Floor, Shanti Vihar Commercial Complex, Ring Road, Indore (Opposite Central Bank of India, near Navlakha Square). Ground-level two-wheeler and four-wheeler parking is available right in front of the complex.

faqs.question: What should I do in case of a medical emergency?
faqs.answer: Aarogya Family Clinic is an outpatient primary care facility and does not operate an emergency trauma center or intensive care unit. For life-threatening emergencies (chest pain, acute breathlessness, seizures, or severe trauma), please proceed directly to the nearest hospital emergency casualty.
